scenario: AITA for having a photo of me with my friend’s girlfriend as my phone wallpaper? | I’m 23M. My friend Charley and I were tight back in college. We even lived together our second year. I met her at a New Year’s party when Charley brought her. I knew about her since before Charley even started dating her. I try my best to not be a creep around her or when discussing her with Charley. Yesterday, I had dinner with just Charley. We had a good time catching up. We didn’t talk much about his girlfriend until he noticed my phone wallpaper as we were waiting for the check. I just told Charley what I have already told him before, that I was a fan of her before they even started dating, but I respect their relationship and he doesn’t have anything to worry about. I still haven’t gotten an apology from Charley.
